assessment.summary: This study investigated the frequency of knockdown resistance (kdr) and dieldrin resistance (rdl) alleles in Anopheles arabiensis populations from the Lower Moshi irrigation schemes in northern Tanzania. Mosquitoes were collected between July 2005 and August 2006. Molecular analysis of 477 successfully genotyped An. arabiensis revealed an absence of the Vgsc L1014S mutation, but a high frequency (0.48) of the rdl resistant allele, with significant seasonal fluctuations in genotype proportions. Permethrin susceptibility bioassays were also conducted, showing varying mortality rates over the study period.
